_doc: 130 holds. Source of truth after bootstrap; see docs/design/16-gazetteer.md and tools/validate_data.py.

holds.name: The Lighthouse
holds.notes: The Lighthouse's seat (Clarion). The bridge lights were kept lit all through the Howling. No toll, ever. Kindle, elder of the Keepers, lives on the bridge. The News keeps a desk here.

holds.name: Anchorage
holds.notes: Barges chained together into a floating town on the poisoned river.

holds.name: Saltlick
holds.notes: Worked by debtors. The Salt discipline site.

holds.name: Gnarly
holds.notes: Built in the shell of a Buckaroo's travel centre. A Wheelwrights garage. Driver start.

holds.name: Pyramid
holds.notes: A fighting pit. Rivals offer single combat here.

holds.name: Beale
holds.notes: Chapter house of the Players.

holds.name: Weigh Station
holds.notes: Counts every rig that crosses.

holds.name: Siege
holds.notes: An old battlefield fort over the river.

holds.name: Brace Win
holds.notes: The dam that keeps the river in its bed. A crossing over the gates.

holds.name: Barge Town
holds.notes: Home of the Gar (road gang).

holds.name: Crossroads
holds.notes: Rumors say a deal was once made here with something in the maelstrom.

holds.name: Mudflat
holds.notes: Sharecroppers in debt to Tum Tum.

holds.name: Helena
holds.notes: Half the bridge is out. A rope crossing.

holds.name: Red
holds.site: Shreveport, on the dry Red River
holds.notes: Where the Red riverbed road meets the Twenty.

holds.name: Ferry
holds.notes: A ferry over a small living river.

holds.name: Partridge
holds.notes: A caravanserai on the state line. Hall of the Tankermen. Hardholder start option.

holds.name: Stockade
holds.notes: The west edge of the Forty. Home of the Twister Riders.

holds.name: Gallows
holds.notes: The hanging‑judge town. Posts bounty gigs.

holds.name: Rock
holds.site: Little Rock, on the dry Arkansas
holds.notes: The Arkansas riverbed road runs west from here.

holds.name: Temple
holds.notes: A hocus congregation.

holds.name: Spillway
holds.notes: Crosses the Tennessee. Hydro power.

holds.name: Fuse
holds.notes: Vault diggers, and home of the Diggers. A rival to the Savvyhead.

holds.name: Mammoth
holds.notes: A Down entrance.

holds.name: Derby
holds.notes: Crosses the Ohio.

holds.name: The Vault
holds.notes: Nobody has opened the inner vault. Rothschild wants it.

holds.name: Shoals
holds.notes: Crosses the Tennessee.

holds.name: Abbey
holds.notes: Miniature cathedrals.

holds.name: Sinkhole
holds.site: Bowling Green, the car museum and its sinkhole
holds.notes: A Driver collector's hook.

holds.name: Dog Head
holds.notes: Fence market and home of the Odd Lot. Chopper start.

holds.name: Burning Water
holds.notes: Burning Water's seat (Parcher). An eternal refinery fire: what can't be refined is burned. Harrowgate's lights are visible from the flare stacks.

holds.name: Capitol
holds.site: Baton Rouge, the capitol tower and the I‑10 bridge
holds.notes: The southern crossing.

holds.name: Dustwich
holds.notes: Savvyhead start.

holds.name: Mobile
holds.notes: A hold built on rail cars that rolls along the coast line.

holds.name: Sweetwell
holds.notes: Seat. Sets the water price across the southwest.

holds.name: Dome
holds.site: Austin, the capitol and the university

holds.name: The Stack
holds.notes: A five‑level interchange. Whoever holds it watches three interstates.

holds.name: Border
holds.notes: The main crossing south onto the Eighty‑Five.

holds.name: The Teeth
holds.site: The Permian Basin, a mobile camp
holds.notes: Home camp of the Teeth (road gang, see [18](18-sub-factions.md)). Moves every season.

holds.name: Twice
holds.notes: Goat herders, raided twice a year.

holds.name: Drift
holds.notes: Run by Crine, Dremmer's lieutenant in the Teeth.

holds.name: Last Stop
holds.notes: The edge of the Loud. West of here, the Ten still howls.

holds.name: Gullet
holds.site: A Rio Grande canyon near Del Rio
holds.notes: A choke point on the riverbed road.

holds.name: Gemela
holds.notes: Border's twin across the dry bed.

holds.name: Pesca
holds.notes: Builds land yachts that sail the dry Bravo.

holds.name: Cerro
holds.notes: Cerro's seat (Otilia). A mountain‑ringed city of steel and cement. The biggest hold in the south.

holds.name: Mouth
holds.notes: Where the Bravo meets the Gulf.

holds.name: Tajin
holds.notes: Home of the Watchers (cult). A maelstrom site (Echo, secondary).

holds.name: Barrow
holds.notes: Mourners: home of the Mourners. The Mend discipline site. Hocus start.

holds.name: Southmost
holds.notes: The edge of the Loud. The Eighty‑Five keeps going to a megacity nobody has come back from.

holds.name: Pellet
holds.notes: Seat.

holds.name: The Arch
holds.notes: Crosses the Mississippi. Starts singing at 9:00.

holds.name: Fork
holds.notes: Crosses both the Mississippi and the Ohio.

holds.name: Quake
holds.notes: The ground still shifts.

holds.name: Cross
holds.notes: Home of the Cross‑folk (cult). Hum‑touched early (6:00).

holds.name: The Track
holds.notes: Races decide disputes. Driver rivals.

holds.name: Highwater
holds.notes: Seat. Runs the winter ice roads.

holds.name: The Loop
holds.notes: Down entrance (the old freight tunnels).

holds.name: Motor
holds.notes: The best garage in the north. Home of the Wheelwrights.

holds.name: The Falls
holds.notes: Crosses the Niagara.

holds.name: Mill Town
holds.notes: Winter home of the Whiteout (road gang).

holds.name: The Tunnel
holds.notes: Crosses the Detroit River.

holds.name: Pen
holds.notes: The 401 east of here runs into the Loud.

holds.name: Spaghetti
holds.notes: The biggest interchange on the map.

holds.name: Kudzu
holds.site: A north Georgia town under vines

holds.name: Painted Barns
holds.site: Barns with old roadside signs, near Chattanooga
holds.surplus_text: information (the painted signs still mark routes)

holds.name: The Exchange
holds.notes: Seat. The only lender on the map.

holds.name: Mirror Town
holds.notes: The Mirror discipline site.

holds.name: The Kingdom
holds.site: A castle of painted concrete, Orlando

holds.name: Circus
holds.notes: Skinners.

holds.name: Sawgrass
holds.notes: The edge of the Loud. The Seventy‑Five south of here still howls.

holds.name: Harrowgate
holds.site: The Houston skyline and the space center dishes
holds.notes: Seat. The endgame.

holds.name: Wisher
holds.notes: Falls to the Hum at 6:00. The Echo discipline site.

holds.name: The Gondola
holds.site: An airship crashed between two towers
holds.notes: Cable‑car trade between the towers.

holds.name: Krin's Nest
holds.notes: Home of the Family (secret society, see [18](18-sub-factions.md)). The Rot discipline site.

holds.name: Junction
holds.notes: The only crossing that's under every river. The Waking meet here in secret. Quarantine start (the stasis bunker is beneath it).

holds.name: The Pumphouse
holds.notes: Half‑working. The Hex discipline site.
